sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and the step you have taken. We value our ongoing partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and always aim to support your operations with our extensive inventory and top-tier service. 

We have carefully reviewed your request; however, we have already provided our best possible price for this combination of terms. We must therefore maintain our offer at €5.20 per unit. As a complete package, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
